high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post featuring a tattoo on someone's forearm. The tattoo design is intricate and appears to be inspired by the concept of Sisyphus from Greek mythology. The main elements of the tattoo include: Sisyphus: A figure is depicted rolling a large boulder up a hill, which is a central motif in the story of Sisyphus. Sun: Above the figure, there is a detailed drawing of the sun with rays extending outward. Planets: Several planets, including Saturn, are shown in orbit around the sun, adding a celestial theme
